# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want TEAMYRA to be a welcoming, professional open-source project where contributors can collaborate on technical work without harassment, discrimination, intimidation or personal attacks.

## Expected behavior

Be respectful, discuss ideas rather than people, give actionable technical feedback, assume good intent where reasonable, protect private information, and keep project discussions relevant to TEAMYRA.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, doxxing, publishing private credentials or user data, deliberate disruption, and repeated bad-faith behavior are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit or remove content, close discussions, reject contributions, or restrict participation when needed to protect the project and its contributors.

Security vulnerabilities and leaked credentials must be reported privately according to [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
